You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `modules/input/imwayland.c`**
- The line that previously set the preedit text to an empty string (`""`) has been modified to set it to `NULL`. This change is made in the function `gtk_im_context_wayland_focus_out`.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug that was introduced in a previous commit (49b17e6c) where clearing the preedit text by using an empty string still counted as existing preedit text. By changing the preedit text to `NULL`, the code now correctly indicates that there is no preedit text present, thus fixing the misbehavior in terminal emulators as reported in the linked issue.
